comment: bc-evts: the score event replay, pinned in Go (TestReplayScoring_GoldenTable, internal/engine/score_replay_golden_test.go) and mirrored in JS (web-mobile/js/__tests__/score_replay_golden.test.jsx) by every case marked jsMirror (individual, engi, fixed-order team and kachinuki). A case whose lines hold a baseline is Go only (jsMirror false): a screen folds its taps on top of the server's last confirmed match and never folds a baseline. Each case's lines are replayed after its head in EVERY order; want.match lists only the fields it pins (wire names), want.outcomes each event id's outcomes, sorted.

cases.name: headline: taps after a finish are turned away, in every order they arrive
a tap after a finish is turned away and changes nothing
two removals of two marks both land
a strike past two is capped, and so is the other side's once the bout is decided
the same strike on two devices counts twice
eventSeqs names each session's highest logged seq, a seq never logged below it included
the second foul lands an H named by the foul; removing it by that id takes it off
an event id already in the log counts once
a finish counts its own tap once and holds out the tap it never saw
a tap after a kiken is turned away: the kiken stands
two taps after a kiken are both turned away, in every order
overtime after a kiken is turned away too
a tap after a fusensho is turned away
a foul and a point after a finish with a hantei are turned away: the hantei stands
flags counted after an engi finish are turned away
a fixed-order bout fusensho keeps the other side's point, and clearing it gives back the score
a kachinuki pairing the match holds no row for (one added by hand) is made by its first event, and two devices tapping it both count
a kachinuki first bout the match holds no row for is made by its first event; its fighter seats a side that holds none, or the same one again, never another
a representative pick and the verdict on a tied representative bout
a kiken cache: an event older than its migration baseline is before it and clears nothing
a fusensho cache: an older event is before the baseline, a newer one is turned away
a team bout's baseline marks carry b: ids a removal names
a kachinuki bout fought again in overtime is no longer recorded
engi flags: a fifth flag lands, the sixth is capped, a removal at 0 has no target, a repeated id counts once
a fixed-order bout: the second foul lands an H named by the foul, and a strike ends a tie
a team match takes no match-level ippon, and its encounter overtime counts up and down
a kachinuki encounter takes no match-level overtime; a later bout's fighter is the bout's, and its winner follows it
the representative bout takes no fusensho, a verdict only on a level score, and a cleared verdict takes the Ht off
a fixed-order team match a kiken closed keeps its numbered bouts open, and closes the rest
a fixed-order event on a bout the match holds no row for makes the row, within the team size
a team match's pool representative bout takes pool.rep picks, each side its own, the later by stamp winning
two representative picks for one side at the same stamp are ordered by id
